comments.value:
It looks like the VCC cannot find your installation of Unity. Does it point to the correct version on the Settings screen? Does the 'pathToUnityExe' field in your settings.json file point to a valid install of Unity?
If you close the VCC and open the project up in Unity, what is its state?

@{5de9405aea7cc52772fcc359|full_name}: 
> Does it point to the correct version on the Settings screen?
Yes
> Does the 'pathToUnityExe' field in your settings.json file point to a valid install of Unity?
Yes
> If you close the VCC and open the project up in Unity, what is its state?
Project refuses to open, crashes during splash screen.

@{5f2d204b74493130abcdca6e|full_name}: Will you try again with the latest release? We made some changes that may solve your migration issue. Version 0.2.3 is available via "Update" button in app, or you can download the installer from https://vrchat.com/home/download

You can try migrating again with the latest release (0.2.7) which bypasses Unity during the migration to keep it simpler. If you are still unable to use the new VPM-style packages in your project, I'll need a minimal copy of your project to investigate further.
